subject.title: [Feature]: Add X-Actual-Model header to expose runtime model in HTTP responses

question: What actual-runtime-model contract should Gateway expose for non-streaming and streaming OpenAI-compatible HTTP responses?
rationale: A normal response header cannot reliably cover the streaming fallback case after SSE headers have already flushed, so implementation needs maintainer intent on the public API shape before code is queued.

options.title: Define unified metadata contract
options.body: Document and implement one contract for non-streaming metadata plus streaming SSE-compatible metadata across Chat Completions and Responses.

options.title: Limit to non-streaming headers
options.body: Add a header only where the selected model is known before headers are sent, accepting that streaming clients need a separate follow-up.

options.title: Defer HTTP response metadata
options.body: Keep this issue open behind broader session/runtime metadata work and avoid adding response fields until selected-versus-resolved model semantics settle elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Define unified metadata contract
recommendation.body: Document and implement one contract for non-streaming metadata plus streaming SSE-compatible metadata across Chat Completions and Responses.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest prior review context and history on the relevant Gateway HTTP/API contract surface.
